data_fields.name: aggro_range
data_fields.donor_constant: var1 high 16 bits x actor scale (A_Look); 0 = no cap (A_Chase)

data_fields.name: aggro_all_around
data_fields.donor_constant: var1 low 16 bits non-zero = all around; zero = front cone

data_fields.name: behind_reach
data_fields.donor_constant: MELEERANGE 64 fixed units x actor scale

data_fields.name: retarget_cooldown
data_fields.donor_constant: threshold = info painchance on missile attack; decremented per A_Chase call

data_fields.name: boss_closest_budget
data_fields.donor_constant: none (full scan) for closest; 2 for non-closest

best_idea: Give each enemy a persisted round-robin cursor and examine at most two in-game players per look, so the cost of finding a target stays fixed as the player count grows.
decision_why: A cursor plus a per-call budget bounds zone NPC aggro when many players are in range, which the server tick needs; adapt because the donor budget is per enemy per call (not a global per-tick budget), it spends slots on spectators and invisible players, and its behind-branch overwrites the distance parameter, which we must not copy.
acceptance: Server test: with 10 players in range and one NPC, each call examines at most 2 in-game players, and the NPC acquires a visible player within 5 calls, with the target sequence asserted from a fixed seed.
